title: 中国人民银行副行长陈德霖：人民币债券稳定优势凸显，香港融资枢纽崛起
speaker: Chen Derling

segments.en: Secondly, to support Hong Kong's diversified financial market, financial market in Hong Kong has been traditionally anchored by stock, bond, gold, commodity, derivatives, or sub-market, and there are great potential to develop further. In 2017, the bond connect started that opened up the FIC market and opened up a new chapter.
segments.zh: 其次，支持香港多元化金融市场。香港传统以股票、债券、黄金等为主，潜力巨大。2017年债券通启动，开启了固定收益市场新篇章。

segments.en: I was the deputy governor of the PBOC at that time, Chen Derling. Mr. Chen Derling was the director of Hong Kong MA. We joined together and hit the drum about the ring to mark the beginning.
segments.zh: 我当时是人民银行副行长，与香港金管局总裁一起敲锣开市。

segments.en: In the past 10 years, the high quality bond insurance in Hong Kong has been growing up. A lot of the sovereignty issues, the sustainable bond in Hong Kong, that supports the directive markets development and other related products. Inflation and interest rate are not stable, Chinese bond sovereignty bond is stable. This is the feature of Chinese bond and it shows the comparative strengths and it attracts the international investors.
segments.zh: 过去十年，香港优质债券发行增长，主权债、可持续债券支持市场发展。通胀和利率不稳定，但中国主权债券稳定，这一特征吸引国际投资者。

segments.en: RMB financing cost is relatively low that offers the opportunity for Hong Kong. Hong Kong should seize this opportunity and attract international investors to come to Hong Kong and get finance here. Hong Kong will then develop as the major financing hub.
segments.zh: 人民币融资成本较低，香港应抓住机遇，吸引国际投资者来港融资，发展成为主要融资枢纽。
